title: TwoSum
question: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

title: InsertNodeInBST
question: Given the root node of a binary search tree (BST) and a value to insert, insert the value into the BST such that the tree remains a valid BST. Return the root of the tree after insertion.
